summary: JPMorgan European Growth & Income plc - Ordinary Shares is an open-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by JPMorgan Funds Limited. The fund is co-managed by JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) Limited. It invests in the public equity markets in Europe. The fund primarily invests its portfolio in the financial sector. It primarily invests in growth and value stocks of companies. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolios against the FTSE World Europe ex UK Net Index. JPMorgan European Growth & Income plc - Ordinary Shares was formed in 1929 and is domiciled in the United Kingdom.
summary_fr: JPMorgan European Growth & Income plc - Ordinary Shares est un fonds commun de placement d'actions à capital variable lancé et géré par JPMorgan Funds Limited. Le fonds est co-géré par JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) Limited. Il investit sur les marchés boursiers publics en Europe. Le fonds investit principalement son portefeuille dans le secteur financier. Il investit principalement dans des actions de croissance et de valeur d'entreprises. Le fonds compare la performance de ses portefeuilles à l'indice FTSE World Europe ex UK Net. JPMorgan European Growth & Income plc - Ordinary Shares a été créée en 1929 et est domiciliée au Royaume-Uni.
